name: New device sign-in
description: Security alert sent when an account is accessed from an unrecognised device or location.

origin.note: Design: bulletin — rule-led, monospace metadata, two actions of deliberately unequal weight, no imagery.

subject: New sign-in to your {{ product.name }} account
preheader: If this was you, nothing to do. If it wasn't, secure the account now.

body.description: Opening paragraph explaining what triggered the alert.
body.default: Someone signed in from a device we haven't seen on this account before. The details are below.

details.description: Sign-in metadata as `label` / `value`. Set `mono` on values a person may need to read character by character, such as an IP address.

location_caveat.description: Why the location may look wrong. Omitting this generates support tickets — IP geolocation is routinely off by a city.
location_caveat.default: Location is estimated from the IP address and can be inaccurate, especially on mobile networks or a VPN.

action_url.description: Where to secure the account. This is the urgent path and gets the filled button.

confirm_url.description: Optional "this was me" acknowledgement, which stops the alert repeating and is worth offering.

security_note.description: What happens if they do nothing. Reassurance belongs after the action, not before it.
security_note.default: You don't have to do anything if this was you. This message is a record, not a request.
